themes.title: AI hardware unwind
themes.summary: Nvidia fell 14.01% to $125.53 after reports of an SEC accounting probe; Arm fell 14.09% and Micron 13.89% to $594.51 (The Closing Print; JournalArta; Schwab).

themes.title: Worst week since April 2025
themes.summary: The S&P 500 and Dow both closed in correction, and the week was the worst since the tariff turmoil of April 2025; the S&P 500's seven-day losing streak is the longest since February 2020 (Schwab; AP).

themes.title: Volatility jumps
themes.summary: The VIX volatility index rose 26.2% to 35.89 on Friday and was up about 86% for the week; only 46% of S&P 500 stocks were above their 200-day moving average (The Closing Print; Schwab).

themes.title: Bond yields fall, gold drops
themes.summary: The 10-year Treasury yield fell to about 4.92% from 5.15% a week earlier, while gold fell about 4% on Friday to near $3,515-$3,539 (The Closing Print; JournalArta).

themes.title: Rate hike priced in
themes.summary: CME FedWatch showed 92% odds of a December Fed rate increase and more than 80% odds of two or more increases by next June, after hawkish Fed minutes (Schwab).

sectors.name: Technology
sectors.note: Weakest sector; the technology fund (XLK) fell 7.27% Friday and 12.49% for the week, led by chipmakers (The Closing Print).

sectors.name: Consumer Staples
sectors.note: The only sector fund to rise Friday, with XLP up 0.67%; Colgate-Palmolive and Kraft Heinz each rose 1.89% (The Closing Print; JournalArta).

sectors.name: Health Care
sectors.note: Nearly flat, with the sector fund down 0.12%; UnitedHealth rose 2.84% (The Closing Print; JournalArta).

sectors.name: Industrials / Consumer Discretionary
sectors.note: Among the weaker groups Friday, with industrials down 3.09% and consumer discretionary down 2.95% (The Closing Print).
